content.title: Gannon University SAT, ACT & GPA Requirements for Admissions
content.text: Gannon University SAT requirements play an important role in the admissions process, which evaluates applicants through a holistic lens. In addition to SAT or ACT scores, the university reviews GPA, extracurriculars, essays, and recommendations, seeking students with both academic strengths and personal achievements. Gannon University SAT scores are generally between 1030 and 1260 or ACT scores between 21 and 27, reflecting the university’s academic expectations. The application is then fortified by having a GPA of around 3.4 or higher, considering that Gannon prefers a student who can show academic proficiency, leadership, and some kind of community engagement. This well-rounded approach to admissions ensures that Gannon University is admitting students who are both academically prepared and active contributors, ready to thrive in its cross-disciplinary and rigorous educational environment. With this comprehensive admissions process, Gannon can ensure that incoming students will be prepared to make meaningful contributions to both campus and their communities. Below is an outline of Gannon University’s key admission requirements: Requirements Details Application Platform Common App or Gannon University Application SAT Scores Average of 1160 ACT Scores 21–27 GPA Typically around 3.4 or higher Application Requirements 1 Letter of Recommendation Personal Essay Extracurricular Activities Application Fee $25 (fee waiver information not available) Gannon University SAT Score Requirements Gannon University utilizes SAT scores as part of a holistic admissions process. Its competitive applicants have average Gannon University SAT scores between 1030 and 1260. Strong SAT scores improve an application; however, the university places equal value on GPA, extracurricular activities, essays, and recommendation letters. Such a balanced approach allows Gannon to review not only academic potentials but also personal qualities for well-rounded review. Ultimately, it is looking for students with a more balanced growth and preparation for college life. Gannon University SAT Requirements Gannon University SAT scores play a crucial role in the admissions process. The middle 50% of admitted students usually score between 1030 and 1260 on the SAT. While a higher Gannon University SAT score can strengthen your application, Gannon University takes a holistic approach, considering extracurricular involvement and personal essays alongside test scores. The average GPA of admitted students is around 3.4. A high GPA demonstrates academic consistency, which is highly valued in the admissions process. Average GPA of Admitted Students The average GPA of admitted students at Gannon University is generally around 3.4 on an unweighted scale. This indicates strong academic performance across various subjects, with students demonstrating solid abilities in challenging coursework. GPA Ranges for Admission Gannon University admits students across a variety of GPA ranges, reflecting its inclusive approach. The middle 50% GPA range for admitted students at Gannon University typically falls between 3.3 and 3.7. Students with GPAs outside this range are encouraged to emphasize their strengths in other areas, such as extracurricular activities, leadership roles, or a strong personal statement, to create a well-rounded application. Gannon University Acceptance Rate Gannon University’s acceptance rate is approximately 77%, making it a moderately selective institution. The university's holistic admissions process allows students with a range of academic and personal experiences to be considered for admission. Conclusion Gannon University evaluates applicants through a holistic lens, considering SAT, ACT, and GPA scores alongside extracurricular activities, personal essays, and recommendations.
